# StayAwake

> StayAwake is a free macOS menu bar app (macOS 14+, Apple Silicon) that keeps a closed MacBook awake on battery and switches itself off before heat, a low battery or the clock make that a bad idea. Made by René Weteling (https://www.weteling.com).

## What it does

- One click in the menu bar runs pmset -a disablesleep 1 through a small root helper (SMAppService launchd daemon)
- Shows CPU, GPU and battery temperature, battery level, time held and which rule is closest to tripping
- Alerts when the power cable comes out while it is armed

## Safety rules

- Release on CPU, GPU or battery temperature, macOS thermal pressure, a battery floor, allowed hours per weekday, lid closed on battery for too long, idle, no network and a hard time cap
- Unreadable sensors count as a trip
- The helper holds a lease the app renews every 10 seconds. A crash, hang or force quit restores sleep within 60 seconds, a reboot restores it at boot, and a 12 hour ceiling applies no matter what
- The helper can run exactly two commands, pmset -a disablesleep 1 and 0, and only accepts the signed StayAwake app

## Facts

- Price: free for noncommercial use, PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0
- Distribution: signed and notarized DMG on GitHub releases, not the Mac App Store (it needs a root helper)
- Privacy: no sensor data leaves the Mac; only crash reports go to Sentry, without paths, and they can be switched off
